```js
export const meta = {
  name: 'wide-then-fail',
  description: 'Six parallel echo agents, one reducer, then a deliberate failure',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fan' }, { title: 'Reduce' }, { title: 'Fail' }],
}
const W = ['red','green','blue','cyan','amber','violet']
phase('Fan')
const out = await parallel(W.map(w => () => agent(`Reply with only the word ${w}.`, { label: `echo ${w}`, phase: 'Fan', model: 'haiku' })))
phase('Reduce')
await agent(`Reply with only the number of words in: ${out.join(' ')}`, { label: 'reduce', phase: 'Reduce', model: 'haiku' })
phase('Fail')
throw new Error('deliberate probe failure')
```
